title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Apple Blackcurrant Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Elf Bar ElfLiq Apple Blackcurrant delivers a rich and fruity blend of crisp Apples and juicy Blackcurrants, balancing sweet and tart flavours in perfect harmony. The Apple brings a tangy, orchard-fresh bite, while the Blackcurrant adds a deep, dark berry richness with a delightful tang. Together, they create a smooth and satisfying fruit combination with a complex, multilayered character. Blended for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this 50/50 VG/PG nicotine salt e-liquid ensures a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. Best suited for low-powered pod kits and starter vape devices, Apple Blackcurrant provides a vibrant and flavour-packed vape with discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Elf Bar ElfLiq brings the most popular Elf Bar disposable flavours into a 10ml e-liquid format, providing a cost-effective and sustainable way to enjoy signature flavours.
